observations.behavior: Adds an optional onNewTask callback prop to TaskSelector, removing the previous openTaskInput dependency, and updates the button to invoke this callback instead of the router.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the TaskSelector to delegate task creation without navigating, supporting a tile-based workflow rather than a full-page composer.

observations.behavior: Changes the test assertion from checking openTaskInput to checking the new onNewTask callback, and updates the test description to reflect the new behavior.
observations.posthog_connection: Updates tests to verify the new callback behavior, not the removed router behavior.

observations.behavior: Removes the import of openTaskInput from the router, indicating the component no longer depends on that router utility.
